messages:
Maya Chen: Quick end-of-quarter status sweep — posting what shipped / slipped for our cross-team OKR items. TL;DR: infra ships mostly done, private-deploy UI slipped due to SSO dependency. Details below.

Maya Chen: Shipped: dedicated-pool autoscaler (PR merged), console route-level metrics (backend+frontend), initial model-catalog telemetry (sampling mode).

Theo Park: +1 on autoscaler. Deployed to staging yesterday; throughput looks stable. Need one more e2e for spike handling (small load test).

Jason Liu: Slipped: private-deploy UI (frontend flow + QA) — blocked by SSO integration from people-ops. Removing from "on track" until SSO window confirmed.

Anika Patel: Ownership callout: Jason will own private-deploy UI until we ship; Maya will own rollout checklist and communication; Olivia please coordinate SSO test window with People Ops.

Olivia Gomez: Pinged @people-ops (security & infra) last night, they can do SSO test slot next Tue 10-12 PT. Confirming with them now.

Samir R: FYI eng-sre needs a 48h cert rotation lead time before GA — please build that into the rollout timeline or we will need to postpone a day.

deploy-bot: [deploy] dedicated-pool-autoscaler v1.0 -> staging :rocket: (logs: https://ci.company/job/1234)

Theo Park: Code review pings: @Jason Liu can you +1 infra changes in https://git.company/repo/pulls/345? It's blocking the autoscaler canary.

Jason Liu: On it, starting review now. If I hit the macOS flake, I may request rerun on linux agents.

Maya Chen: Risk notes: model-catalog telemetry depends on version-pin logic scheduled for next sprint. If pinning is delayed, fallback is "telemetry-lite" (sampling only) to avoid blocking OKR.

Anika Patel: Action items (owners & provisional due dates):
- Jason Liu: finish SSO PR + private-deploy UI fixes (ETA: +14 days).
- Theo Park: run e2e spike test & share results (ETA: +3 days).
- Samir R: reserve cert rotation window + confirm constraints (ETA: +5 days).
- Olivia Gomez: confirm SSO test slot with People Ops and share test plan (ETA: +2 days).

Maya Chen: Any objections to marking "console route-level metrics" as shipped for the OKR? :thinking_face:

Theo Park: No objections from infra. :thumbsup:

Jason Liu: No objections.

Olivia Gomez: Fine by me.

Anika Patel: Approved.

Maya Chen: Thanks — I'll update the OKR doc and mark the shipped items after lunch. Leaving thread for async follow-ups; please @mention me for blockers.

Samir R: noted.

Jason Liu: small follow-up: test harness flaky on macOS agents, filed issue #789 (https://tracker.company/issues/789). If flakiness blocks my review, will ask for linux-only runs.

Theo Park: Thanks Jason. If needed, we can do linux-only CI for the canary to keep momentum.

Maya Chen: Good plan. End of sweep — thanks everyone.
